name: covera
description: Runs Suresoft COVER EE coverage builds from natural-language requests: identifies the original build for C/C++, C#, and Java projects (CMake, Make, Visual Studio/MSBuild, STM32CubeIDE, Maven, Gradle), runs the instrumented build while keeping the original output paths, and keeps the successful setup for later builds. Also looks up a module's coverage results on the COVER server and recovers C/C++ files excluded by analysis errors by verifying a toolchain configuration fix on the COVER server. Requires a COVER EE Local Agent installation.
